description: This file defines the QualificationLicenseController class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a frontend component called 'license-list' during the preRender phase.

classes.name: QualificationLicenseController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing qualification license views in the admin plugin, extending AbstractVueController and initializing a Vue component.
